BiblicalUsage: Chaldeans come near and accuse the Jews before Nebuchadnezzar, and the men who accused Daniel are cast into the lions' den. The slanderers end up devoured themselves.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe slander eats the slanderer in the end, because the lions' den is where false accusation lands.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace; Daniel in the Lions' Den
